info.name: Arweave HTTP Node Transactions API
info.description:
The core Arweave node REST API for submitting and retrieving transactions, uploading data chunks, querying wallet balances, fetching blocks, and inspecting network state. Requests target any Arweave node on port 1984 (default gateway arweave.net). Amounts are denominated in winstons (1 AR = 10^12 winstons).


Contact Support:
 Name: Arweave Team
 Email: team@arweave.org

request.description: Returns the confirmation status of a transaction including the block height it was mined into, the block hash, and the number of confirmations.

request.description: Fetch a single field from a transaction. Valid fields are: id, last_tx, owner, tags, target, quantity, data, data_root, data_size, reward, signature.

variable.description: (Required) Transaction ID (Base64URL encoded SHA-256 of signature)

request.description: Download the data payload associated with a transaction. Returns the Base64URL decoded data with the appropriate Content-Type header based on the transaction's Content-Type tag.

variable.description: (Required) Transaction ID (Base64URL encoded SHA-256 of signature)

request.description: Returns the byte offset of a transaction's data within the Arweave weave along with the data size. Used to retrieve specific chunks.

item.name: Get transaction data with MIME type hint

variable.description: (Required) Transaction ID (Base64URL encoded SHA-256 of signature)

request.description: Download transaction data with the response Content-Type determined by the file extension. For example, /tx/{id}/data.html returns the data with Content-Type text/html.

response.name: Transaction data returned with inferred Content-Type

variable.description: (Required) Transaction ID (Base64URL encoded SHA-256 of signature)

request.description: Retrieve a full transaction object by its transaction ID. Returns 202 if the transaction is pending (not yet mined into a block).

Submit a new signed transaction to the Arweave network. Transactions can transfer AR tokens, store data, or both. Use format=2 for v2 transactions which support large data via chunked uploads. The reward field must be in winstons obtained from the /price endpoint.

response.name: Verification failed or invalid transaction format

item.name: Get decoded transaction data by ID

request.description: Retrieve and return the decoded data payload for a transaction directly by its ID. This is a shorthand for /tx/{id}/data and sets the appropriate Content-Type header from the transaction's tags.

variable.description: (Required) Size of data in bytes (use 0 for token-only transfers)

request.description: Calculate the minimum fee in winstons for storing the specified number of bytes and optionally sending to a target wallet address. An extra fee is included for the first transaction sent to a new wallet address.

response.name: Fee in winstons returned as a numeric string

variable.description: (Required) Size of data in bytes (use 0 for token-only transfers)

request.description: Calculate the minimum fee in winstons required to store the specified number of bytes. Use bytes=0 to get the fee for a pure token transfer with no data.

response.name: Fee in winstons returned as a numeric string
